telos.statement: Determine the strongest product process Lichess App can honestly implement that carries a player from 'I want to get better at chess' to a next act they judge worth taking, a personally relevant learning process, and an honest account of what has and has not changed.
telos.success_condition: A named process survives falsification; it works in every state including the one where no personal pattern is ever found; every progress construct names its own unit and none of them is rating; the highest remaining uncertainty is FIELD rather than REPO or RESEARCH.

current_state.summary: Decision Lab records a chess decision BEFORE the engine answers: the player states a candidate move and a confidence, commits, and only then sees the engine. The BACK HALF of a learning path is built, gated and shipped: a six-bucket detector (MIN_BUCKET_N=30 inside and outside, so 60 revealed decisions before any claim); a claim carrying its scope and refutation condition; a pre-registered narrowed search after an import (floor 20); drills on claim-matched positions; player-authored learning rules; a spaced retrieval queue with grades derived from the record; transfer tests; refutation and retirement; a journey ledger whose stages are ACCUMULATING, NOTHING_SEPARATED, CANDIDATE, CONTEXT_CHECKED, PRACTISED, PROMPTED_CHECK, WATCHED_IN_PLAY, REFUTED, RETIRED, each carrying its construct, denominator, next act and stated limit; a scalar pointer (record -> detect -> drill -> grade) that now names waiting rule work; and two gates refusing a goal rendered beside a count and a stage number rendered without its construct. 41 gates, each with a positive control that must go red. THE FRONT HALF DOES NOT EXIST. A player arriving cold meets the machinery with nothing having told them what this product uniquely does. The front door explains the ordering (decision before engine) but never says that the product is trying to find something that RECURS SPECIFICALLY IN THEIR DECISIONS, which is the only thing distinguishing it from Chess.com analysis, Lichess analysis, puzzles or Aimchess. There is no entry frame carrying the player's own aspiration. The goal note exists but renders only on the record screen, below the readings, and only once the record holds something. The IMPORT SCREEN is where a player with history first meets a conclusion: it lists six buckets, each with an accuracy rate and its n, at equal salience and high on the screen; the honest conclusion ('the types measured are closer to each other than their own sampling error; there is a lowest number but it does not separate') renders far below, after a ledger and two methodological paragraphs.
known_constraints: EVIDENCE CEILING: the frozen mechanism research states CAUSALITY (FIELD), INTERVENTION (OWNER) and OUTCOME (FIELD) are unreachable by the discovery pipeline under any result, and that the claim ladder is unchanged by sample size. No surface may promise improvement or attribute rating change to the product.

TIME TO VALUE IS AN INSTRUMENT CONSTRAINT, NOT ONLY A COPY PROBLEM: 60 revealed decisions before any claim is possible, and the research-grade personal residual needed >= 1786 admissible blitz games. A prior run recorded that the calibration wait is an instrument constraint and not automatically removable friction.

AN IMPORT CANNOT PRODUCE A CALIBRATION GAP. Old games carry no confidence stated before the engine spoke, so imported evidence is move accuracy only. This is the structural reason prospective decisions contain a kind of evidence history cannot supply, and the product has never said so as a REASON TO ACT.
OWNERSHIP IS LOAD-BEARING: the decision is committed before the engine reveals anything. No layer may turn the app into an engine-answer feed.

REPOSITORY LAWS: LAW 1 forbids record readings while a decision is open; LAW 2 permits one primary action per screen; R1 forbids a percentage without its denominator and now forbids a goal rendered in the same element as a count; R3 keeps the engine silent before commit. A ratchet holds the front door's word count and only comes down.
FIELD STATE: n = 3 cold users, two of whom could not complete the core move. That was repaired and has never been revalidated. Nobody has ever been observed using the shipped journey layer.

A PRIOR PAIRED R&D RUN on a different provider lineage concluded that the compact five-prompt audit surface should be kept, and layered distinctions used selectively where they separate evidence validity from representation, action selection from execution, prompted performance from transfer, and process progress from rating outcome. Its one finding naming a missing SURFACE rather than a missing distinction: surface the personal-inference promise BEFORE the dashboard machinery, using the advancement goal as the entry frame.

decision_blocked.statement: What is the player's path, and where is the binding constraint on it? Four readings are live. H-1: the gap is at the FRONT — the back half is built and nothing tells an arriving player what the product uniquely does before they meet it, so the value that would justify the wait is never offered. H-2: the gap is time-to-value — even a perfect frame cannot make the first session's payoff worth 60 decisions, and the build should target the first session instead. H-3: the gap is the import screen — it is where a player with history first meets a conclusion, and its visual claim (six rates, one visibly lowest) is stronger than its textual one (nothing separated). H-4: nothing should be built; only FIELD can move this.
decision_blocked.current_default: H-1. Build an entry frame carrying the player's own aspiration and the personal-inference promise, placed before the machinery, plus one next act with its payoff stated. Add no new progress number, no programme, no rating denominator, and no change to the detector.
decision_blocked.reversal_condition: Evidence that the front is not the binding constraint: that a player told exactly what the product uniquely does still judges the next act not worth taking, which is H-2 and a different build; or that the import screen's visual-over-textual claim is severe enough to outrank the entry frame, which is H-3 and a smaller, cheaper build.

signals: OWNER/FIELD, mentor Nicolas Bandurek: 'you built feedback, you have not built a KPI'. He framed the product as managed effort toward a user-selected goal rather than a mistake-reporting tool, said the customer journey begins from the player's desired improvement and not from the detector, said generic chess mistakes are not interesting and the value becomes interesting when the system moves from statistical error to something personal, and named time-to-value as a blocker. This is a signal about a missing user contract. It is NOT research authority for the correct KPI, and it does not establish that a prescribed programme works.

REPO: the product already refuses to estimate an unknown distance and already distinguishes 'enough decisions and nothing separated' from 'not enough decisions', calling the former an answer rather than a silence. The question is whether that discipline extends to a path or breaks on one.
REPO: the import screen's own conclusion is correct and is rendered last. Nothing about it is dishonest in words; the ordering and salience are the whole of the concern.

REPO: a player can know exactly what to do and rationally decide it is not worth doing. Action clarity, execution ability, expected payoff, effort and continuation are five different things, and no representation collapses them.
